note: Open-prairie RV resort on SD-79 south of Hermosa, between Rapid City and Hot Springs and handy for Custer State Park's east side: long angled pull-through rows graded from 30-amp discount sites to 100-ft Ultimate sites, plus cabins and tent sites, an event centre with restaurant and nightly activities, heated pool and hot tub, pickleball and a fenced dog park. Monthly stays are offered alongside nightly, but short-term booking is the front door. Run by Streamside RV Resorts. --Claude
